plan: Check in (Radisson Blu recommended). Evening walk on the Bund; light dinner near People's Square. Keep it flexible in case of flight delay.
Yu Garden + Yuyuan bazaar in the morning, Shanghai Museum in the afternoon (both <30 min from the hotel). Optional Cantonese lunch at Canton 8 (2★).
Shanghai Tower 118F observation deck (cross the river). Dinner at 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana — its published hours include Wednesday 18:00–21:00.
Tianzifang lanes, then Xintiandi. Dinner at T'ang Court — open Thu lunch + dinner; verify the Monday closure and the 15-minute table hold policy.
Free day / shopping. Dinner at Da Vittorio (2★) — closed Mondays, open Friday; confirm the reservation window.
Lantern Festival falls on Sat 20 Feb 2027 — Yuyuan/old-city area is the focal point; go early, book dinner away from the crowds.
Taian Table (3★) dinner — the one booking to make first, because its opening days are NOT published and it may not open on a Sunday. Fallback: Fu He Hui (2★).
travel: Taian Table ≈ 29 min; Fu He Hui ≈ 32 min (estimate)

plan: Checkout. Note: T'ang Court and Da Vittorio are closed on Mondays — do not plan a farewell lunch there.
